inputs.name: ai_provider
inputs.label: AI Provider
inputs.helpMarkDown: Select the AI provider to use for code reviews. Choose **OpenAI** for OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Choose **Anthropic** to use the Anthropic API (Claude models).

inputs.name: api_key
inputs.label: AI API Key
inputs.helpMarkDown: API key for the selected AI provider. For OpenAI use your OpenAI secret key. For Anthropic use your Anthropic API key.

inputs.name: ai_model
inputs.label: AI Model
inputs.helpMarkDown: The model to use for code reviews. For OpenAI: `gpt-4`, `gpt-3.5-turbo`, etc. For Anthropic: `claude-sonnet-4-6`, `claude-opus-4-6`, `claude-haiku-4-5-20251001`, etc.

inputs.name: api_url
inputs.label: API URL Override
inputs.helpMarkDown: Override the default API endpoint. Useful for proxies, Azure OpenAI deployments, or other compatible endpoints. Leave blank to use the provider default (`https://api.openai.com/v1` for OpenAI, `https://api.anthropic.com` for Anthropic).

inputs.name: bugs
inputs.label: Check for bugs
inputs.helpMarkDown:
Specify whether to enable bug checking during the code review process.

- Set to `true` to perform bug checks.
- Set to `false` to skip bug checks.

Bug checking helps identify and address potential issues in the code. Default value is `true`.

inputs.name: performance
inputs.label: Check for performance problems
inputs.helpMarkDown:
Specify whether to include performance checks during the code review process.

- Set to `true` to perform performance checks.
- Set to `false` to skip performance checks.

Enabling performance checks helps identify and address potential performance-related issues in the code. Default value is `true`.

inputs.name: best_practices
inputs.label: Check for missed best practices
inputs.helpMarkDown:
Specify whether to include checks for missed best practices during the code review process.

- Set to `true` to perform best practices checks.
- Set to `false` to skip best practices checks.

Enabling best practices checks helps ensure adherence to coding standards and identifies areas for improvement. Default value is `true`.

inputs.name: file_extensions
inputs.label: File Extensions
inputs.helpMarkDown:
Specify a comma-separated list of file extensions for which you want to perform a code review. This input helps narrow down the scope of the code review to specific file types.

**Example:**
```plaintext
".js,.ts,.css,.html"
```

Make sure to provide the file extensions without spaces after the commas.

inputs.name: file_excludes
inputs.label: Files to exclude
inputs.helpMarkDown:
## Files to Exclude Configuration

### Description
Specify a comma-separated list of file names that should be excluded from code reviews. This is useful for excluding sensitive files or preventing certain files from being reviewed.

### Format
Provide a list of file names separated by commas. For example: `file1.js, file2.py, secret.txt`

### Default Value
If no files are specified, all files will be considered for code review by default.

inputs.name: additional_prompts
inputs.label: Additional Prompts
inputs.helpMarkDown:
Specify additional prompts as a comma-separated list to enhance the code review process.

- Add multiple prompts separated by commas.
- These prompts will be used in conjunction with the main code review prompts.
- Ignored if **System Prompt Override** is set.

**Example:**
```plaintext
Fix variable naming, Ensure consistent indentation, Review error handling approach
```

inputs.name: system_prompt
inputs.label: System Prompt Override
inputs.helpMarkDown:
Provide a fully custom system prompt for the AI. If set, this **completely replaces** the built-in prompt — the bugs, performance, best practices, and additional prompts inputs are ignored.

Leave blank to use the built-in dynamic prompt assembled from the options above.

**Example:**
```plaintext
You are a senior engineer reviewing a pull request. Focus only on security vulnerabilities and data validation issues. Respond in markdown with bullet points. If there are no issues, respond with NO_COMMENT only.
```

inputs.name: max_tokens
inputs.label: Maximum Tokens
inputs.helpMarkDown: Specify the maximum number of tokens allowed for the AI API response. This value ensures the request stays within the model's token limit. Also used to skip files whose diff is too large to review.
